products.name: Synthetic Summit Backpack

research.title: Synthetic trail evaluation
research.text: The light Trail backpack is suitable for hiking. The backpack is not waterproof and requires a rain cover.

research.title: Synthetic summit evaluation
research.text: The Summit backpack has a waterproof shell.

knowledge_base.title: Synthetic trail care FAQ
knowledge_base.text: The Trail backpack is not waterproof; use a rain cover in wet conditions. Clean the fabric with a damp cloth.

knowledge_base.title: Synthetic summit FAQ
knowledge_base.text: The Summit backpack has a waterproof shell but unsealed seams.
